target_customer: Schools and teachers in the Middle East and Africa
problem: Teachers spend hours creating and grading assessments; Skillza's Quest tool simplified creating, distributing and measuring them, alongside live online extracurricular classes sold to schools.
business_model: B2B2C sales to schools plus paid live online classes

founders.name: Anand Bhashyam
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a packaging designer. Gulf News names him as founder.

investors: Regional angels including staff from Facebook UAE and Careem

technical_complexity.rationale: Assessment authoring and grading tool, standard web engineering with bilingual content.

defensibility.rationale: School contracts gave some stickiness but assessment tooling and online classes were widely available.

market_need_then: Gulf News reported agreements with more than 15 UAE schools reaching over 50,000 students and over 25,000 students taught live online, per the company.

branding.domain_note: skillza.co; the domain later showed a registrar parking page

brand_strength.rationale: Name is close to Skillz the US gaming company, which dominates search results; no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Skillza raised a seed round in April 2022 and signed school agreements, but YC lists it Inactive and PitchBook calls it out of business, with the domain now a parking page. No shutdown date, post-mortem or reason is public, so the cause is not known.
notes: Seed amount not disclosed by Gulf News; one aggregator (thecompanycheck) says 125K in June 2022 and PitchBook says 500K for Skillza Learning, both unverified single sources. Shutdown rests on PitchBook (single database) and YC status. Gulf News says founded 2020, YC says 2021. PitchBook lists Abwaab and Nagwa as competitors, undated, so none recorded. A separate 'Quest' landing page may be a different product. Gulf News reports the founder as age 34 but this is not recorded as age_at_founding.
